description: This source file is a Java Spring MVC Controller class named ContentImageController. It manages static content images in a web application, including functionalities such as displaying image repositories, paginating images, adding new images, and removing images. It interacts with content service layers and handles HTTP requests to facilitate content image management in an admin interface.

classes.name: ContentImageController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing static content images, providing endpoints for viewing, creating, uploading, and deleting images within the admin content management system.

methods.name: displayFileBrowser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the file browser interface for content images.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display images for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: pageImages
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch a paginated list of image file metadata, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: displayContentImagesCreate
methods.description: Displays the form for uploading new content images.

methods.name: saveContentImages
methods.description: Processes form submissions to upload and store new content images associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific image file from content storage.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set the menu context for the UI, marking the current menu as active.
